title: Unity can crash on CheckDeviceStatus during specific Inference Engine actions
symptom: Unity can crash on CheckDeviceStatus when executing specific Inference Engine actions.
trigger: Execute the specific Inference Engine actions described by Unity's known-issue entry.

title: Unity Editor can crash on AudioManager::InitFMOD on Windows
symptom: The Windows Editor can crash on AudioManager::InitFMOD while performing various Editor actions.
trigger: Perform Editor actions on Windows in an affected configuration.

title: Unity can crash on keywords::PrintKeywordSpaceInfo when uninstalling URP
symptom: The Editor can crash in keywords::PrintKeywordSpaceInfo when Universal Render Pipeline is uninstalled in a specific project.
trigger: Uninstall Universal Render Pipeline in the affected project configuration.

title: Removing the VR Module dependency prevents the URP Sample from compiling
error_signature: Removed VR Module dependency prevents URP Sample from compiling
symptom: The URP Sample does not compile after the VR Module dependency is removed.
trigger: Use the affected URP Sample/template configuration after removal of the VR Module dependency.

title: OnSubmit can trigger indefinitely after dismissing the mobile keyboard
error_signature: OnSubmit event is triggered indefinitely on UGUI Input Field after dismissing keyboard
symptom: On iOS and Android, a uGUI Input Field can repeatedly trigger OnSubmit after the software keyboard is dismissed.
trigger: Dismiss the keyboard while using the affected uGUI Input Field on iOS or Android.

title: Opening a project for the first time can crash in TexturesD3D12::CreateTextureInternal
symptom: Unity can crash in TexturesD3D12::CreateTextureInternal when a project is opened for the first time.
trigger: Open an affected project for the first time while using DirectX 12.

title: Moving carved NavMesh Obstacles can increase CPU usage
error_signature: Increased CPU usage when moving NavMesh Obstacles with carving enabled
symptom: CPU usage increases when moving NavMesh Obstacles that have carving enabled.
trigger: Move NavMesh Obstacles while carving is enabled.

title: DirectX 12 Player can crash when focus changes in Exclusive Fullscreen
error_signature: Player crash when switching focus in Exclusive Fullscreen mode with DirectX 12
symptom: A DirectX 12 Player can crash when focus is switched while Exclusive Fullscreen mode is active.
trigger: Switch application focus while the Player is using DirectX 12 in Exclusive Fullscreen mode.

title: Loading a VFX object from a DisableTypeTree AssetBundle can crash CachedReader
symptom: Unity can crash with CachedReader::OutOfBoundsError when loading a VFX object from an AssetBundle built with DisableTypeTree.
trigger: Load a VFX object from an AssetBundle that uses DisableTypeTree.

title: DirectX 12 may not be used even when first in the Graphics API list
error_signature: DX12 Graphics API is not used, when it is first in the graphics API list
symptom: Unity may start without using DirectX 12 even when DX12 is first in the configured Graphics API list.
trigger: Put DirectX 12 first in the Graphics API list in an affected configuration.

title: Unity Package Manager installations can fail with EPERM on Windows
symptom: Package installation can fail non-deterministically on Windows with an EPERM operation-not-permitted error.
trigger: Install packages on Windows in an affected Unity version.

title: Async HTTP callback after domain teardown can crash Scripting::LogException
symptom: Unity can crash in Scripting::LogException when an asynchronous HTTP callback executes after the scripting domain has been torn down.
trigger: Allow an asynchronous HTTP callback to execute after scripting domain teardown.

title: Unity can crash on Animator::OnPlayableUnbind when exiting Play Mode after RigBuilder rebind
symptom: Unity can crash on Animator::OnPlayableUnbind when exiting Play Mode after RigBuilder rebinds during Animator evaluation.
trigger: Exit Play Mode after RigBuilder rebinds during Animator evaluation.

title: Concurrent UnityWebRequest churn can cause Android IL2CPP native SIGSEGV
error_signature: Native SIGSEGV in libunity.so Curl_splaygetbest / curl_multi_perform
symptom: On Android IL2CPP, concurrent UnityWebRequest churn can cause a native SIGSEGV in libunity.so around Curl_splaygetbest or curl_multi_perform.
trigger: Run concurrent UnityWebRequest activity in the affected Android IL2CPP configuration.

title: Windows Player can silently crash on Application.Quit after loading an Addressables asset
error_signature: Windows Player silently crashes when using Application.Quit() after loading Addressables asset
symptom: A Windows Player can silently crash when Application.Quit is called after an Addressables asset has been loaded.
trigger: Load an Addressables asset and then call Application.Quit in the affected Windows Player.

title: DirectX 12 Player can crash on UnityMain when rapidly switching focus in Fullscreen Window
symptom: A DirectX 12 Player can crash on UnityMain when application focus is rapidly switched while using Fullscreen Window mode.
trigger: Rapidly switch application focus while the Player uses DirectX 12 in Fullscreen Window mode.

title: GPU Occlusion Culling can fail to cull obstructed instances with GPU Resident Drawer
error_signature: GPU Occlusion Culling fails to cull obstructed instances when GPU Resident Drawer is enabled
symptom: Obstructed instances can remain visible because GPU Occlusion Culling does not cull them when GPU Resident Drawer is enabled.
trigger: Enable GPU Resident Drawer and GPU Occlusion Culling in an affected project.
